authority_model.domain_fact_authority: Never A7_MODULE.json; resolve the owning fact class/module/provider.

required_invariants: One A7_MODULE.json exists at repository root on each bound module's default branch.
module_id, repository_id and provider_repository_id must exactly match A7.
The manifest contains routing pointers, not duplicated domain facts.
Every routing entrypoint declares both ref and path.
Non-default working/publication refs are explicit; default branch is never assumed to be the current engine source.
A7 ownership profile must be loaded before domain mutation.
Operations links to peer modules do not imply containment or ownership.
ai_resolution_order: Fetch A7_MODULE.json from that module repository's default branch using immutable repository identity.
Load the central ownership profile and authority assignment.
Follow only the routing entrypoint relevant to the requested task.
Fetch the target ref/path live when current state matters.
Mutate only the owning domain repository/provider, then provider-read back.
Treat A7_MODULE.json as routing metadata, never domain truth.
mutation_rule: Changing A7_MODULE.json requires provider readback and A7 manifest observation reconciliation. Do not edit generated Pages/HTML to change the routing contract.
